summary: Tightened GPT geometry admission and closed test gaps found by source review of DRV-005. Tested only against tables built in the test.

geometry_rule_references.normative_text: UEFI specification chapter 5. https://uefi.org/specs/UEFI/2.10/05_GUID_Partition_Table_Format.html returned HTTP 403 on 2026-11-10, so the normative wording was not read.

review: Source-only review of DRV-005 by a fresh same-session subagent that was not given the author conclusions. Commits after it have tests and mutants but were not reviewed again.
review_findings_not_changed_in_code: UniquePartitionGUID is not checked: lookup never uses it and the rule could refuse a real table without protecting anything.
The double read of input fields is handled by requiring a stable kernel-owned buffer, documented in gpt.h.
The userdata refusal cannot identify mislabelled data; the claim was narrowed instead.
host.c READ(10) enforcement was outside this review; the extent-to-LUN binding has no integration code yet.
limitations: No real S24 GPT has been read; the strict rules may refuse it, and relaxing any rule would need a measurement.
The geometry rules were checked against secondary sources, not the normative UEFI text.
No PHY, IOMMU, MCQ or boot behaviour is established.
